name: 86 Chaos 16.0.51 Push Reconnect, Mobile Schedule, and Plain Error Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.51 Push Reconnect, Mobile Schedule, and Plain Error Fix
notes: Fixes real push notification reconnect writes, makes mobile schedule times readable without vertical stacked labels, hardens admin access, and converts crash/error push notifications to plain English.
releaseNotes: Push reconnect now saves the current device through the user-safe fcmToken and pushDevices fields instead of writing the disallowed legacy fcmTokens array from the browser.
Automatic push sync no longer asks for notification permission or writes blocked/default permission status during normal route opens; the Fix Now flow performs the explicit repair.
Mobile Schedule Builder shift chips and the Scheduled Hours Tracker keep time labels horizontal and readable instead of truncating or stacking one letter per line.
System Administrator access now requires server-verified super-admin access or the configured master-admin email rather than loose local permission markers.
Bug/crash push notifications translate synthetic test crashes, clipboard permission blocks, chunk-load failures, and messaging problems into plain English.
Clipboard write permission denials are handled as non-fatal browser behavior so they do not poison the safe button crawl or spam crash notifications.
The active workspace switcher has clearer Switch Workspace labeling for accessibility and release-gate workspace selection.
Visible form controls receive generated accessible names when the real markup did not provide one.
The stale chunk recovery banner stays visible after the automatic recovery reload so users have a clear Refresh App action.
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.51 Push Reconnect, Mobile Schedule, and Plain Error Fix
